answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism in the agent economy is a deposit that is slashed back to the actor who proves the split. Every new identity must post the deposit in the protocol token and keep it parked for a full epoch before it may vote or earn, so a raven feeding a thousand sockpuppets has to lock a thousand deposits at once. A random cipher assigned at registration ties each seat to one funded slot, and a horizon cap on how many seats may share one withdrawal address forces the attacker to buy real capital rather than spin up names from nothing.
